implementation: Client-only stock wand and modeless ClassicUO controls backed by an independently gated native U7 development command family.
verified: Exactly one reserved wand after connection/reconnection/load; stock art; cannot drag; no native inventory object or weight.
Disabled debug capability rejects mutations, catalog and inspection; audit capability remains separate.
9780 native item catalog entries; name/category/shape search, frame validation, mapped/unmapped filters, item and horse previews.
Eight native reagent stacks of 30, learned 72-spell book, original reagent consumption, native quantity frames and 127/128 limits.
Item creation into backpack, actor inventory and native surface elevation; blocked and unsupported targets rejected.
Recursive copies retain quantities, contents, learned spells/bookmark and marked-stone destination; party/story/linked corpses protected.
Exact 16-level and 512-object trees copy; 17-level and 513-object trees rejected; actual native record exhaustion/refusal/recovery leaves no partial copies.
Original pirate equipment and every occupied native equipment slot copied to fresh actor/item identities; base attributes copied, conditions and AI fresh.
Absolute validated stat batches, effective values, HP/mana clamping, 12 invalid range cases, refill and all 7 condition operations.
Original combat produces a persistent linked corpse; dead-actor cleanup refused; native resurrection preserves actor/possessions with no helper leak.
Native clock preserves day, updates schedules; all 7 weather values and party teleport execute through native operations.
Cleanup protects untracked possessions; load clears registry and rejects stale generations and lifetime IDs.
Repeated debug sequences do not duplicate mutations; paused catalog/inspection preserves native RNG/clock and spell prompts.
Native save/reload preserves generated creatures, reagent quantities and stats; copied run saves independently and refuses overwrite.
Four save-copy boundary tests: independent data, existing destination, corrupt/changing source and path bounds.
UI replay: all panels, Enter search, creation, typing/movement exclusion, both target cancellation stages, native spell priority, reconnect/load and movement recovery.
Native and client spell-effect regressions; observer-on/off native outcome parity.
Installed normal launcher creates wand by default; disposable installed-build smoke and capture pass.
compatibility_notes: No UO spell rules, invulnerability or quest-flag editor. Native original gameplay functions remain authoritative.
Created specimens clear the native temporary flag so they persist and leave identity-linked corpses.

Nonhuman corpse possessions are moved through a detached native holder around unchanged ResurrectBody: original RefitInventory assumes HUMAN-class actors. Native humans retain the ordinary refit path.
Unsupported structural/internal shapes remain browseable; unmapped art is identified. Advanced weather presentation and global lighting remain separate.
Cycle guards and rollback branches were reviewed; tests exercise real allocation exhaustion and blocked placement, not injected mid-operation allocator faults or corrupt cyclic saves.
Build includes existing parallel renderer/art working state; commit contains only wand/launcher/qualification/documentation deltas.
